routes.label: Share equally and count what remains

question: Write the quotient first, then the remainder. Quotient and remainder: \(7\div3\).
solution: \(7\div3=2\) with a remainder of 1. Giving each of the 3 schoolbags 2 books uses \(3\times2=6\) books and leaves \(7-6=1\). Since \(1<3\), this is a valid remainder. Write the quotient first, then the remainder: \(2,1\).
